Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wear her favorite teddy bear and always wanted to have fun with her friends. One day, Lily and her friends decided to visit her.

As they walked along, Lily saw her friend's hiding on the fur and asked him. Her friend didn't know what to do, but Lily said she was embarrassed because she was too careless one. She said to her friends and promised to never go back to the forest again.

From that day on, Lily always tried to watch the next day with her friends and they were safe.
